questions.stem_markdown: Two particles $P$ and $Q$, of masses $0.1\,\text{kg}$ and $0.3\,\text{kg}$ respectively, are at rest on a smooth horizontal plane. $P$ is projected directly towards $Q$ with speed $4u\,\text{m s}^{-1}$. At the same instant, $Q$ is projected directly towards $P$ with speed $u\,\text{m s}^{-1}$. After $P$ and $Q$ collide, $P$ moves with speed $2\,\text{m s}^{-1}$ and $Q$ moves with speed $4\,\text{m s}^{-1}$.

mark_scheme_items.guidance_markdown: For use of conservation of momentum once. Must have correct number of terms. Allow $$g$$ included with all 4 masses and sign errors only.

For expression or equivalent difference. Allow sign errors only. Using *their* 14 which is the larger of the 2 values found in part (a). If only one value of $$u$$ found in part (a) then **M0**. If no value for $$u$$ substituted, then **M0**.

Allow $$-183.6, \pm \frac{918}{5}$$. **This mark is dependent on full marks in part (a).** Condone negative values for $$u$$ and $$v$$ used. If calculating both KE losses, then largest must be chosen for this mark. Condone $$\pm 184$$ CWO.

The van and trailer are connected by a light rigid tow-bar which is parallel to the road. There are resistance forces of $X\,\text{N}$ on the van and $120\,\text{N}$ on the trailer. The driving force produced by the van's engine is $2500\,\text{N}$. The tension in the tow-bar is $T\,\text{N}$, and the acceleration of the van is $0.4\,\text{m s}^{-2}$.

The block $Q$ hangs vertically below the point $O$. The angle between $OA$ and the vertical is $30^\circ$ and the angle $BOQ = \alpha^\circ$ (see diagram).

questions.stem_markdown: A van of mass $2500\,\text{kg}$ travelling at speed $v\,\text{m s}^{-1}$ experiences a resistance force of $kv^2\,\text{N}$. The constant power of the van's engine is $62.5\,\text{kW}$. The van begins to ascend a hill inclined at an angle $\theta^\circ$ to the horizontal. The van travels along a line of greatest slope of the hill. The speed of the van at the start of the hill is $20\,\text{m s}^{-1}$, and its acceleration is $5a\,\text{m s}^{-2}$. Later, on the same hill, the speed of the van is $30\,\text{m s}^{-1}$, and its acceleration is $a\,\text{m s}^{-2}$. The power of the van's engine remains at $62.5\,\text{kW}$, and the resistance force remains at $0.5v^2\,\text{N}$.
